LanguageData.CL_Settings_Section_Typography_Caption: Resize every Lightweave-rendered surface. Vanilla UI is unaffected.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_Section_Motion_Caption: Transitions and hover feedback on Lightweave-rendered surfaces.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_Section_Misc_Caption: Render-pipeline overlays and trace logs for performance work.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_Theme_Help: Each preset swaps palette, type stack and background art.
LanguageData.CL_Theme_Scadrial_Sub: Cold pewter - allomantic copper - atium violet
LanguageData.CL_Settings_FontSize_Help: Scales every Lightweave-rendered surface. Vanilla UI is unaffected.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_ReduceMotion_Tip: Disable the staggered fade-in and hover-lift animations on Lightweave-rendered surfaces.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_PerfOverlay_Tip: Draw a small FPS/CPU/GPU/latency readout in the top-right corner, above every window and vignette.
LanguageData.CL_Settings_RenderDiagnostics_Tip: Emit a once-per-second trace log of render-pipeline timings (call rate, cache hit rate, build/paint cost, event breakdown) on the Lightweave channel. While enabled, the global log level is lowered to Trace so the diagnostics are visible, and restored when disabled.
